retraction_notice: The adaptive bootstrap-threshold model reported here (R^2=0.889, slope=0.914) does not reproduce and is retracted. Refit on the released data gives R^2~0.11 (slope reversed); on valid rows only, R^2~0.015. Silhouette does NOT predict bootstrap-ARI reproducibility in these data. The reported R^2=0.889 does not reproduce from the released benchmark and was not verified against it before release. See ERRATUM_2026-07-08.md.
circularity_statement_correction: The prior statement that the 47 benchmarks exclude the manuscript datasets is FALSE: TCGA-COAD (the manuscript primary cohort) is present in the benchmark. The independence claim is withdrawn.
empty_input_artifact: 12 TCGA + 2 GEO rows had bootstrap ARI=1.0 from adjusted_rand_score on degenerate ground truth (n_true_clusters=1); these are artifacts, documented in KNOWN-ISSUES.md, and drove the spurious fit.
do_not_use: Do not use this model for threshold calibration. No adaptive-threshold model is supported by the data.

superseded_fields_retained_for_record.circularity_statement: None of the 47 benchmarks include TCGA-COAD, GSE28521, GSE64018, or GSE80655 (the manuscript analysis datasets).

fit_quality.description: 89% of bootstrap ARI variance explained by silhouette score
